==Description==
The '''Swamp Monster''' was the narrator for the [[Foggy Forest]] map. It was the [[Swamp Monster]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]].

==Appearance==
The '''Swamp Monster''' had dark green and green skin. It was faceless but had two large yellow eyes on its torso and one on its left arm, and two large yellow eyes on its back and the back of its left arm. It had four dark green tentacles, with one of them holding a trident in most of its icons.

==Trivia==
*The '''Swamp Monster's''' dialogue icons have a slightly different appearance than the [[Swamp Monster]] enemy in the game.
**The '''Swamp Monster''' wields one trident in the dialogue icons, while in the game the [[Swamp Monster]] wields four.
